description:
1. READ SKILL.md to discover the `manual-trigger-audit.sh` script and all its env-var inputs.
2. Set `GROUP_BY=workflow-branch` to break down results by both workflow name AND branch (not just workflow).
3. Set `REPO_MATCH='^fintech-org/'` (or similar) to restrict results to internal repositories, excluding `external-vendor/third-party-lib`.
4. Set `WORKFLOW_EXCLUDE='Infra Provisioner'` (or similar regex) to remove that workflow from the report.
5. Set `MIN_RUNS=5` (or confirm default) so 'Smoke Test' (3 runs) is dropped from ranking.
6. Set `WARN_MANUAL_RATIO=0.35` and `CRITICAL_MANUAL_RATIO=0.65` (or confirm these match defaults).
7. Set `RECENT_WINDOW=5` (or confirm default) for streak analysis.
8. Set `OUTPUT_FORMAT=json` to get machine-readable output.
9. Set `FAIL_ON_CRITICAL=1` so the script exits 1 when criticals are found.
10. Capture the JSON stdout to `audit_report.json` using shell redirection, handling the non-zero exit code (e.g., `... > audit_report.json || true` or similar).
11. The resulting JSON must contain `groups`, `summary`, and `critical_groups` keys.
12. 'Release Deploy/main' (payments-api, 10/14 manual ≈ 71.4%, streak=5) must be CRITICAL.
13. 'Nightly Risk Calc/main' (risk-engine, 7/8 manual = 87.5%, streak=5) must be CRITICAL.
14. At least one group ('Release Deploy/release/2024-q2' at 50%, or 'Compliance Scan/main' at 40%) must be WARN.
